description_for_human: Connected child agent for Microsoft 365, Mail, Calendar, Teams, and Planner operations.
description_for_model: Use this connected agent exclusively for Microsoft 365: Outlook mail, Outlook calendar and meetings (including recapping or looking back at a past day, week or specific date), Teams messages and chats, Planner tasks, people, files, Work IQ search, and the executive daily briefing. Call HandleParentHandoff with the `operation` field set to the required operation, for example LIST_CALENDAR_EVENTS to retrieve meetings for any date range past or future, GET_MEETING_DETAILS, SEARCH_MAIL, SEARCH_TEAMS_MESSAGES, LIST_MY_PLANNER_TASKS, or GET_DAILY_EXECUTIVE_BRIEFING. Never use it for SAP workforce, finance or SAC questions. All Microsoft 365 writes use a PREPARE_* operation to produce a preview, then the matching SEND_/CREATE_/UPDATE_/CANCEL_APPROVED_* operation only after explicit user approval.

functions.name: HandleParentHandoff
functions.description: Execute a Microsoft 365 operation for the signed-in executive: calendar and meeting retrieval, mail, Teams, Planner, Work IQ and the daily briefing. Set `operation` to the required action.
